name: aeromind_registry
default_model_rationale: Demo default chosen on validation evidence only: lower paired CV RMSE than the HGB reference on 5/5 folds (by 0.26 cycles, within fold spread), 0.35 ms single-input CPU latency, and the smallest degradation under the FD001->FD003 shift. Not claimed to be the most accurate model; GRU and Transformer CV means are lower but within fold variability.

models.name: hist_gradient_boosting

official_test.protocol: one prediction per official test engine at its last observed cycle (ledgered, once)

limitations: Trained and evaluated on NASA C-MAPSS simulation data only; not validated on real engines.
Not certified for operational or safety-critical maintenance decisions.
Predicts capped RUL min(RUL, cap); early-life RUL above the cap is not identifiable.
Expects the same operating regime and fault modes as its training subset.
Evaluated on a single validation split (no cross-validation); no variability estimate.
No calibrated prediction intervals for this model.

models.name: xgboost

intervals.description: Symmetric interval prediction ± q, clipped at 0. q is the ⌈(n+1)(1−α)⌉-th smallest absolute residual (vs capped truth) over one seeded random snapshot per calibration engine.
intervals.guarantee: Marginal coverage ≥ level for a snapshot drawn uniformly from a new engine exchangeable with the 15 calibration engines (averaged over calibration draws). Not conditional on RUL range; not valid under distribution shift (other subsets, sensor faults); levels above 15/16 are unattainable.
